name: PancakeSwap AMM V3
description: PancakeSwap V3: A More Efficient and User-Friendly DEX on BNB Chain

methodology.UserFees: All trading fees paid by users
methodology.Fees: Total trading fees - sum of LP fees and protocol fees. LP fees vary by pool type (0.25% for most pools, with some special pools having different rates). Protocol fees are 0.05% for most pools.
methodology.Revenue: Pancakeswap collects amount of swap fees for Treasury and buy back CAKE.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swap fees collected by Pancakeswap - distribute to Treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swap fees collected to buyback and burn CAKE: 15% fees in 0.01%, 0.05% tier pools, 23% fees in 0.25%, 1% tier pools

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Total trading fees - sum of LP fees and protocol fees. LP fees vary by pool type (0.25% for most pools, with some special pools having different rates). Protocol fees are 0.05% for most pools

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Swap fees collected by Pancakeswap - distribute to Treasury
Revenue.Swap Fees To Holders: Swap fees collected to buyback and burn CAKE: 15% fees in 0.01%, 0.05% tier pools, 23% fees in 0.25%, 1% tier pools
